summary: End-to-end tested the new Forever Anchor / Shared Memories feature — both backend (13 pytest cases, all PASS) and frontend (public /with/ayesha page, dashboard Wall of Hope, mobile 390px, landing FAQ). All critical acceptance criteria pass: 10 reason chips present with correct testids, dynamic headline updates on chip click (verified reason-type-smile → 'Give Ayesha a reason to smile.'), consent-share-checkbox present, view toggle (view-leave-btn / view-anchor-btn) works, anchor-collection renders with layer-forever / layer-reasons on the public page, category_counts only include consented+shared items ({smile:4, remember:1} after clicks), Wall of Hope groups (wall-group-stay, wall-group-smile, wall-group-remember, wall-group-hope), 10 visibility rows with vis-private-/vis-shared-/vis-forever- tri-state buttons per item, backend enforces 403 on shared/forever for consent_shared=false items, invalid visibility → 400, unauth → 401, public endpoint privacy guard verified (only consent_shared=true AND visibility in shared/forever leak), Landing FAQ item 11 'What are Reasons, Memories, and Forever on an Anchor?' present + item 10 'Can I control exactly what supporters see?' answer contains Private/Shared/Forever, Pillar I checklist mentions 'reasons, memories & forever'. Mobile 390px /with/ayesha: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390), reason chips wrap, collection layers stack. Legacy items render under 'Reasons to Stay' group with felt-btn-{id} present (favorite testid is 'fav-btn-' not 'favorite-'; still functional).

integration_issues.flow: Recipient clicks vis-shared on a NON-consented item
integration_issues.issue: Spec expected: click shows error toast and stays private. Actual: UI marks the shared/forever buttons visually disabled (cursor-not-allowed, faded color) with a title tooltip 'The supporter kept this private' and the onClick short-circuits (no API call, no toast). Backend still returns 403 if bypassed. Better UX in practice, but no toast fires so the user gets a silent, easy-to-miss signal. Consider adding a lightweight inline hint or a toast.info on click of a blocked button.

action_items: (Optional UX) Non-consented visibility buttons are silently disabled. Consider a toast.info or inline pill so users understand why 'Share on my Anchor' can't be toggled on some items.
(Optional testability) Card 'favorite' button uses data-testid='fav-btn-{id}' but review request mentioned 'favorite-'. Align docs or add both aliases for stability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/hope/{item_id}/visibility correctly enforces consent_shared for shared/forever transitions (403), rejects unknown values (400), and requires auth (401). Clean.

sanctuary_public filter is correct: {visibility ∈ {shared, forever}, consent_shared: True}. category_counts is computed after filtering — safe. reasons_count still returns total (public), which is intentional (shows 'X reasons already tucked inside' framing).

Dashboard.jsx blocks non-consented shared/forever via the `blocked` client flag AND the backend enforces 403 — good defense in depth. Consider surfacing a toast when blocked click is attempted (currently silent).
REASONS taxonomy is a single source of truth in /app/frontend/src/constants/reasons.js and reasonLabel/reasonTitle default to REASONS[0] (stay) on unknown keys — safe for legacy items.
add_hope always inserts visibility='private' regardless of supporter consent — correct: recipient controls sharing later.

success_rate.frontend: 9/9 acceptance items pass; 1 minor UX note

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_forever_anchor.py MUST be run serially (pytest -n0) because tests share state via pytest.<attr> across classes. In parallel (xdist loadscope) 5 tests fail due to state not crossing workers — this is a test-infra artifact, not a code bug. To re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_forever_anchor.py -v -n0`. Frontend testids: `vis-{private|shared|forever}-{item_id}` (not `vis-private` alone); `favorite` button testid is `fav-btn-{id}`. FAQ testids follow `faq-question-{n}` / `faq-item-{n}`; new entries are #10 (Private/Shared/Forever control answer) and #11 (three layers explanation). Public page toggle testids: view-leave-btn / view-anchor-btn. Public layers: layer-forever, layer-reasons, layer-memories (when present).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. One minor UX observation: blocked visibility buttons silently short-circuit instead of toasting. Not a functional defect.
